Abstract
This document outlines a unified mathematical framework modeling reality as a self-organizing, resonant
system. It details the foundational ontology, the derivation of the Master Formula governing the global reality
fieldΛ(t), and the hierarchical structure of the governing equations. The framework integrates harmonic su-
perposition, delayed self-reference (causal echo), and non-linear observer feedback to explain the emergence of
stable, coherent reality branches.
2 I. Ontology (What Exists)
1.Substrate (Oscillatory Potential):Reality is a spectrum of coupled modes; the “raw DNA” is a superpo-
sition of harmonics. This is formalized as base components that later interact through feedback.
2.Prime Line (Causality & Time):The system evolves alongtwith explicit delayed self-reference (the
lighthouse / echo) that preserves memory.
3.Temporal Observer Node:An active, saturating non-linearity that integrates the field over a short horizon
(“thickness of Now”) and feeds back—this is the stabilizer that turns high loop-gain into bounded limit
cycles.
